goal: Give pmcro-trail:initialize a real, working link path by implementing the already-specified Test-TrailLink.ps1, closing task-add-trail-link-path-script.

steps.action: Implement plugins/pmcro-trail/skills/initialize/scripts/Test-TrailLink.ps1: the deterministic, read-only link-path script already named in run.initialize.asset.md and the SKILL.md References list but not yet written. Checks trail-not-found, class-a-unsupported, trail-sealed, trail-linked in that exact order; on success returns the same result shape as New-Trail.ps1.

Exercise the new script against real repo data for all 5 documented paths: link success on an open+unclaimed scratch trail, trail-sealed against a real sealed trail, trail-linked against a real claimed trail, trail-not-found against a bogus guid, class-a-unsupported with -Class A. Clean up any scratch trail folders created for this so nothing extraneous is left behind.
Commit the new script and push to origin main.

success_criteria: Test-TrailLink.ps1 exists, is read-only (mints/writes nothing), and checks trail-not-found / class-a-unsupported / trail-sealed / trail-linked in that order
Its success result shape matches New-Trail.ps1 (status, trail_id, task_id, trail_class, path, scratch, files)
All 4 reject codes verified firing against real data with the documented Write-Error "<code>: <message>" convention
No scratch trail artifacts left tracked in git after cleanup
Working tree clean and origin/main matches local main after push
out_of_scope: Running the formal eval suite (tests/run-evals.ps1) or changing eval.yaml status fields
